name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: panes, tools and hooks that live inside a session

plugins.name: breadcrumbs
plugins.description: An always-on pane with what this session is about: the task, your last prompt, what Claude is doing and last said, and the explanations it wrote, saved as notes you can preview.

plugins.name: secrets
plugins.description: Hand Claude an API token without it reading the value: you type it into a field above the prompt, Claude uses it in Bash as $NAME, and it is redacted from every tool result.
